metaDescription: Order custom box matches folders for your brand. Perfect for promotional events and corporate gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom box matches folders combine the classic appeal of matchbooks with a premium folder presentation, making them a standout promotional item for trade shows and corporate events. Unlike standard folders, these feature a built-in matchbox sleeve, perfect for safety-conscious businesses that want a memorable, functional giveaway. Choose from foil-stamped paperstocks to match your brand colors and logo. Ideal for restaurants, hotels, and event planners seeking a unique, branded giveaway that guests will actually use.
